tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: PRIMARY · Grid green. Primary button fill, links, step numerals. White on it 6.6:1. As text: on `background`, `paper`, `wash` (5.9:1+). Not on `accent`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. White 8.2:1.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed. White 11:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `secondary` fills.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: SECONDARY · Red pen. Check marks, the current-language underline, tag stickers, the first-visit numerals. As text 5.5:1+ on white and paper — short labels only. White on it 5.8:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: ACCENT · Pencil yellow. Round stickers, the highlighted line of the hero headline boxes. Only `text-primary` (10.4:1) and `text-secondary` (4.7:1) on it.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: BACKGROUND · White exercise-book paper. Most of the page stays plain white so it reads trustworthy.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Grid sections' ground, under the grid lines. `text-primary` 15:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: SURFACE · Cards. White cards with a `border` edge; body copy always sits on these, never on the grid.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Hover wash behind secondary buttons, nav links, FAQ rows.

tokens.name: wash-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed wash; the open FAQ row.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: TEXT PRIMARY · Pencil-lead ink. Headlines and body on every ground (13:1+).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: TEXT SECONDARY. Captions, hours, hints, footer on white/paper/wash (5.9:1+).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: BORDER · Card edges and dividers (decorative).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges — fields, contact chips (3.4:1+ on white and paper).

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Exercise-book grid line and 田字格 centre cross. Decorative.

tokens.name: grid-line-strong
tokens.usage: Every 4th grid line and the outer edge of each 田字格 box. Decorative.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: SUCCESS · Same grid green, always with a check icon and words.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: ERROR · Darker than red pen (7.8:1 on white) and always with an alert icon and a sentence.

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: Footer ground (deep green blackboard). `on-primary` on it 12.6:1.
